benchmark.timers: Deltas of sglang:forward_execution_seconds_total (extend and decode). The client checks token totals and device/host/storage cache hits before accepting each sample.

execution: Batch one, 32-token prefill, full decode CUDA graph, SGLang JIT router, default dynamic KV partitions and the official Triton assembler. Each run lists its changes to the server settings below.
